skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply economic theories and models to analyze and evaluate real-world economic issues and policies.
Develop independent research skills, including data collection, analysis, and report writing.
Formulate and defend independent conclusions based on research findings.
Work effectively in teams and individually to solve real-world economic problems.
Present research findings clearly and professionally through written and oral presentations.
Identify and solve complex economic issues using analytical and critical thinking skills.
Manage and organize project tasks and timelines effectively.
Demonstrate ethical behavior and responsibility in research and professional activities.
